# Alpha & Omega Analytics

> The options desk built around your plan. No signals. No lottos. Members set a budget and a price range once; A&O shows which of their tickers are worth trading, the strikes that fit their range (ITM, ATM, OTM, nothing under $2.50 a contract), dealer levels (put wall, flip, call wall, GEX, VEX, DEX) and whale options flow on one screen. Educational analytics. Not financial advice and not a signal service.

## Who it is for

Retail options traders (SPX, SPY, QQQ, IWM 0DTE and 1DTE; weekly swings on large caps) who are tired of paying for Discord alerts and want a plan and the reason behind each setup.

## Product

- Your Plan: goal, budget range, price per contract, styles traded, stop rule. The desk filters everything to it.
- Setups: a 1 to 5 read and a 0 to 100 model score per ticker, with the reason and the invalidation.
- Ticker pane: every style from 0DTE to LEAPS, spreads, writing and shares; the member picks ITM, ATM or OTM.
- Dealer map and heatmap: where dealers may pin price or push it faster, in plain English.
- Alpha Flow: large prints tagged bullish, bearish or theta, vertical spreads paired, bought at the ask vs sold at the bid.
- Journal: every tracked trade checked against the member's own rules.
- Ask A&O and a members' community chat.
- A&O never places trades or holds funds. Brokerage connections are read only.

## Pricing

- Desk: $1 for 30 days, then $50/month, billed through Whop. Cancel anytime.
- Free access with delayed data: https://whop.com/alpha-omega-analytics
